findings.title: Computed display config is discarded, raw config returned
findings.body: get_monitor_environment_context copies monitor.config into local `config` and converts schedule_type to its display value, but then returns monitor_environment.monitor.config instead of the local `config`. The conversion is dead code and event context contains the raw schedule_type value instead of the intended human-readable display value.
